items.title: ATB-Market (Ukraine grocery chain)
items.summary: A $400,000 ransom demand appeared on the retailer's website on Oct 5 while its online services were temporarily unavailable; attackers are threatening to leak data.

items.title: Svedala kommun (Sweden)
items.summary: A ransomware attack took all municipal IT systems down and the municipality moved into crisis mode.

items.title: City of Vicksburg, Mississippi
items.summary: City computer systems were temporarily shut down after a ransomware incident; police, fire and 911 services stayed operational.

items.title: University of Illinois Chicago College of Medicine
items.summary: Data was stolen from servers and some systems were temporarily unavailable; the main network and patient care were reported unaffected.

items.title: Osaka Metropolitan University (Japan)
items.summary: Around 500 servers went offline in a ransomware attack, with data on at least 130,000 students and staff potentially exposed.

items.title: Air Traffic and Navigation Services (South Africa)
items.summary: Check Point reports a ransomware attack on operational technology supporting aviation weather services, with suspected data theft; the provider first disclosed malware in that OT environment on Sep 26.

items.title: Keio Corporation (Japan rail and services group)
items.summary: A ransomware attack on group servers, disclosed Sep 26, disrupted payment and reservation functions at multiple group companies.

items.title: Ransomware activity tied to JetBrains TeamCity flaw CVE-2026-63077
items.summary: Reporting links ransomware intrusions to exploitation of a TeamCity vulnerability, CVE-2026-63077; build servers exposed to the internet should be checked and patched.

ransomware.note: Several of these were disclosed in the Sep 26 to Oct 5 window; KonBriefing groups a batch of them under Oct 2, so individual incident dates may be a few days earlier.

items.title: Azure: two incidents across 18 regions in 40 hours
items.summary: Between Sep 29 and Oct 1 Azure logged two separate outages that took gateway services offline across 18 regions and left Azure OpenAI customers in Sweden with failed API calls for about 5 hours 45 minutes, ending 02:15 UTC on Oct 1.

items.title: Windows 11 update KB5124010 crashing applications
items.summary: The KB5124010 update is reported to crash productivity apps, games and media players on Windows 11, a patch-induced disruption worth holding in a pilot ring before broad rollout.

outage.note: No major AWS or Google Cloud outage dated October 2026 was found in today's searches.

items.title: FortiMail zero-day CVE-2026-104286 added to KEV
items.summary: CISA added a CVSS 9.8 FortiMail flaw to the KEV catalog after Fortinet confirmed active exploitation; it lets unauthenticated attackers write arbitrary files to the underlying system.

items.title: Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway zero-days CVE-2026-88771 / 88772
items.summary: CISA's Sep 27 alert covers two exploited critical NetScaler flaws, a command injection and a buffer overflow, each able to enable remote code execution; a further NetScaler flaw, CVE-2026-88779, was reported added to KEV on Oct 4.

items.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager auth bypass CVE-2026-76504
items.summary: A CVSS 9.8 authentication bypass in Catalyst SD-WAN Manager is being actively exploited and was added to KEV; Check Point reported no patch available as of Oct 5.

items.title: Joomla extension zero-days CVE-2026-48939 and CVE-2026-56291
items.summary: CISA added two flaws in the iCagenda and Balbooa Joomla extensions to KEV after active zero-day attacks.

items.title: Southern Company: three utility subsidiaries breached
items.summary: An unauthorized third party accessed limited account and contact information through customer portals at Georgia Power (about 300,000 customers), Alabama Power (about 100,000) and Mississippi Power.

items.title: IFAPME (Belgium vocational training network)
items.summary: An attack on a database, listed Oct 4, may have compromised personal and possibly financial data on around 700,000 people.

items.title: Technical University of Denmark
items.summary: Attackers accessed the university's identity and access management system and downloaded a large volume of data, potentially affecting up to 200,000 current and former users.

items.title: Times Car (Japan car-sharing)
items.summary: A breach affected approximately 6.6 million current and former accounts, with identity-verification documents exposed for 1.6 million of them.

items.title: Typhoon Nolo (Central to Western Pacific)
items.summary: Nolo strengthened rapidly to a Category 3 storm with 115 mph winds and was redesignated a typhoon after crossing the international date line, last placed about 395 miles west-southwest of Lisianski Island moving west at 17 mph.

items.title: Typhoon Choi-wan (Western Pacific)
items.summary: Choi-wan is tracked as a major typhoon in the Western Pacific with winds near 127 mph.

items.title: Bouquet Fire, near Saugus, California
items.summary: The fire, eight miles northeast of Saugus, is threatening residences and energy infrastructure with evacuations and road closures in effect; the Dome Fire near Yosemite also has area, road and trail closures.

items.title: Earthquake: 5 km NNE of Korumburra, Australia
items.summary: A magnitude 4.7 earthquake struck on Oct 02; USGS alert level green, no tsunami.

items.title: Earthquake: 6 km WNW of Wauna, Washington
items.summary: A magnitude 4.2 earthquake struck on Sep 29; USGS alert level green, no tsunami.

physical.note: No earthquake above M 5 appeared in the USGS significant-week feed.
